_comment: morph.py script: one entry per persona. `text` is spoken (drives slot length), `subtitle` is burned on screen, `clip` is the generated persona shot, `seam` hides the cut. Omit `clip` to pass clips positionally via --clips. Add explicit `start`/`end` to override boundary detection entirely.
